subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 8% per annum is Rs. 9120 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 7 years at 8% per annum. Find the sum.
solution:
Given:

The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 8% per annum is Rs. 9120 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 7 years at 8% per annum

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be P.

​According to the question,

(P × 7 × 8)/100 - (P × 3 × 8)/100 = 9120

⇒ (P × 4 × 8)/100 = 9120

⇒ P = 28500

∴ The sum is ₹28500.
